script: I booked my sister's hospital stay—then this shocking mistake happened!. The first thing I did was Google "hospital discounted rates for family." They actually have them—links with the price pre‑filled. I scrolled through a few, picked the one with a kitchen and a seating area, because if she can whip up a light meal tomorrow it'll keep her spirits up. I filled out the reservation form with her name in the "person staying" field, then—Laughing out loud—forgot for a split second and typed my own. Classic. She's checking in at 1 a.male. on Sunday, so I told her to ring the hotel that afternoon to confirm the late arrival, and then call again at 8 or 9 p.male. in case the shift change messed up the note. I hope this eases her mind. My mom and I're footing the bill, so she can focus on the surgery. After sending the email, I realized my title was off—she's having a pre‑cancer surgery, not a regular one. I fixed the headline, but I didn't explain it fully. It's not like… a pre‑cancer… surgery.
